title: Unique Smoky Brazilian Beef Skewers
description: Charred and molten Brazilian dish featuring ground annatto, perfect for a meal prep dinner, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, ground annatto, olive oil, coconut milk, lime juice, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and turmeric, mix well with your hands until just combined
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld
Thread the beef mixture onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked to an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days
